description: Reserved-seat availability (available, limited, sold out) in standard and business class for THSR trains between two stations, with their times. Updated about every 10 minutes. Example: from "台北", to "台中".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

from.description: Departure THSR station: name (台北, Zuoying, 新竹) or station ID (1000).

limit.description: Maximum number of trains to return (default 10).

to.description: Arrival THSR station: name (台北, Zuoying, 新竹) or station ID (1000).

name: thsr_seats
title: High speed rail seat availability
